Hoverlabel objects

Source: R/zz-gen-shared.R
go_hoverlabel.Rd

Used for hoverlabel in 47 places in the schema. go_hoverlabel() creates one; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_hoverlabel(
  ...,
  align = NULL,
  bgcolor = NULL,
  bordercolor = NULL,
  font = NULL,
  grouptitlefont = NULL,
  namelength = NULL,
  showarrow = NULL,
  split = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

align

Sets the horizontal alignment of the text content within hover label box. Has an effect only if the hover label text spans two or more lines One of "left", "right", "auto", or a vector of these. Vectors are accepted only in some contexts (e.g. trace text fonts). Not available in every context.

bgcolor

Sets the background color of the hover labels for this trace Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these. Vectors are accepted only in some contexts (e.g. trace text fonts).

bordercolor

Sets the border color of the hover labels for this trace. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these. Vectors are accepted only in some contexts (e.g. trace text fonts).

font

Sets the font used in hover labels. A go_font() object or named list, with properties color, family, lineposition, shadow, size, style, textcase, variant and weight (see go_font()).

grouptitlefont

Sets the font for group titles in hover (unified modes). Defaults to `hoverlabel.font`. A go_font() object or named list, with properties color, family, lineposition, shadow, size, style, textcase, variant and weight (see go_font()). Not available in every context.

namelength

Sets the default length (in number of characters) of the trace name in the hover labels for all traces. -1 shows the whole name regardless of length. 0-3 shows the first 0-3 characters, and an integer >3 will show the whole name if it is less than that many characters, but if it is longer, will truncate to `namelength - 3` characters and add an ellipsis. Integer in the interval [-1, Inf], or a vector of these. Vectors are accepted only in some contexts (e.g. trace text fonts). Not available in every context.

showarrow

Sets whether or not to show the hover label arrow/triangle pointing to the data point. Logical. Not available in every context.

split

Show hover information (open, close, high, low) in separate labels, rather than a single unified label. Default: FALSE. When set to TRUE, `hovertemplate` is ignored. Logical. Not available in every context.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_hoverlabel object (a named list).

Details

These objects appear in 47 places in the plotly.js schema (properties named hoverlabel), with small differences between them: for example, not every context has every property below. go_hoverlabel() checks the values against the contexts it can be used in; when the object is placed in a figure it is checked again against that context's rules.

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~wt, y = ~mpg, mode = "markers") |>
  update_layout(hoverlabel = go_hoverlabel(bgcolor = "lightyellow"))
